CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   B. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Black, white, and grey

3. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   C. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.

4. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Football.
   C. Damage equipment used for Football.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Football.

5. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.
   C. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.

6. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

7. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.

8. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the costume
   D. Only the volume

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

10. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Remove the need for rules

11. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.
   C. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.
   D. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   B. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

13. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

15. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Rounders and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Fabric Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Puppetry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
